tools.name: search_claims
tools.description:
Claims of the current versions of published claimsets that match the words in q, best match first.

        Search matches words reduced to their stems, not meaning: use the words a paper would use, and try synonyms.
        Quoted phrases match as phrases, -word excludes, `or` gives alternatives. O

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Published claimsets whose current versions match the words in q, best match first, as paper cards (title,
        principal claims, keywords, subfield, version, status). With guarantor (an ORCID iD) and no q: that
        guarantor's claimsets, most recently updated first, for finding the identifier

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
A published claimset: its reading view (format "text", plain text made from the file: read this one to
        understand the paper) or the published file (format "json"). id is the claimset's identifier, such as
        entrylib:2026.000001 for the current version or entrylib:2026.000001@v1 for a g

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description:
One claim with what it rests on (its definitions, evidence, warrants, limitations, the claims it depends
        on and the references they cite): a claim bundle, as a reading view (format "text") or JSON. id names the
        claim: entrylib:2026.000001#C4 (current version) or entrylib:2026.000001@

tools.name: submission_status
tools.description:
The state of a submission, by the id submit returned: pending (waiting for the guarantor), confirmed,
        publishing (with its registry pull request), published (with its identifier), refused (with the reasons) or
        expired. Never its content.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate, score · Private data: get_paper, validate, score, submit · Public sink: score, submit, submission_status · Destructive: get_paper, get_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate, score · Private data: get_paper, validate, score, submit · Public sink: score, submit, submission_status · Destructive: get_paper, get_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
